summary:
Curation 9 ran at 2026-09-26 ~13:40 UTC on HEAD 69d6be2, plus the untracked research/wf_ideas_v4/round9/ and experiments/exp64_overlap_lab/results_info_post_stop.md. The ledger grew from 276 to 279 ideas; there are 36 change records in ideas.json meta.curations[n=9]. Counts c8 -> c9: refuted 157 -> 159, lb-tested 41, lab-tested 20 -> 21, deferred 26, in-plan 31, open 1.

Overlap consensus: the R9 amendment was recorded at 11:06 UTC (CONTEXT.md l.2187-2197), so I-274 is APPLIED. The post-stop exp64 G-B read gives -0.00143 (boot lower -0.00200), which confirms the stop (CONTEXT.md l.2198-2204). I-270 moves to lab-tested, and I-208 stays refuted. Round 9 refuted the PC9-01 'honesty gap' claim, and no user STOP/continue answer is logged, so the default STOP stands.

Round 9 verdict (r9h-2): no honest mechanism can reach R8. R4 needs ~+0.012 in the lab at the ~1/6 transfer, and the judge offers light mode.

Measured rechecks:
- I-276 GT-noise mimicry is refuted (reach 1/83 FN, 1/25 FP). New DIV fact: the loss comes from missing forks and isolated false forks.
- I-222 retention guard moves to deferred (embryo-dependent fallback 33.1%/3.9%; effective weight 0.80). A GPU counterfactual is planned after 29 Sep.
- The notes for the I-177/179/180/181 link family were updated: probes 21-23 are real -0.002 reads; relink OFF on x138 kills readmit; gshift is plausibly subsumed by the flow prior.

New ideas: I-277 DC readmit veto (refuted), I-278 F2 -> P36/#34 (refuted), and I-279 E10 P4b (in-plan, at-risk). New aliases: OOF insertion threshold under I-066; z shift + insertion under I-029.
